We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

  • A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

  • Meaningful work supporting the financial and budget processes of a public-sector organisation

  • A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

    Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

    With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

    Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

    Your impact

    Compliance at Mollie is a competitive advantage — and you'll be the one building it. As a Senior Regulatory Compliance Officer, you'll be at the heart of how we scale responsibly across Europe, turning complex regulatory requirements into practical, automated solutions that actually work for the business. You'll own the frameworks, lead the conversations, and make sure compliance moves at the same pace we do.

    You'll also lead and develop a team of junior and mid-level compliance officers — coaching them, reviewing their work, and helping them grow. Your expertise across AML/CFT, sanctions, and regulatory advisory will set the standard for how the team operates and how compliance is embedded across Mollie.

    This is a role where your work has real reach. The frameworks you build, the policies you shape, and the culture you foster will directly support over 350,000 businesses growing with less friction and more freedom.

    What you'll ship

    • A robust, scalable compliance framework across AML/CFT, sanctions, and governance — designed to support Mollie's rapid European expansion

    • Clear, actionable policies and controls that translate PSD2/3, AMLD6 and EBA Guidelines into practical business requirements

    • Proactive risk assessments and thematic reviews that identify and close compliance gaps before they become problems

    • Compliance embedded into product development lifecycles — working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Operations to make it happen by design, not as an afterthought

    • High-quality regulatory reporting and senior management deliverables, prepared with precision and delivered on time

    • A stronger, more capable compliance team — through structured mentorship, coaching, and quality oversight that raises the bar across the board


    What you'll bring

    • 7+ years of compliance experience within a regulated financial institution — Fintech, PSP, EMI, or (neo)bank

    • Strong, hands-on knowledge of European regulatory frameworks, including PSD2, AMLD, EBA Guidelines and MiCAR

    • Solid experience across both financial crime (AML/CFT, sanctions) and broader regulatory compliance advisory

    • The ability to translate complex regulations into clear, practical solutions — without overcomplicating it

    • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge and influence senior leadership when it matters

    • A proven track record of mentoring or managing junior compliance professionals and elevating team performance

    Grow your way

    At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

    No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

    Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy.

    If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

    Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

    AI at Mollie

    We believe in Always Be Shipping. AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

    About the role.

    • Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability.

    • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams.

    • Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity.

    Make security the reason people trust Ockto

    Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

    Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

    As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

    What you'll do

    You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

    • Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

    • Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

    • Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

    • Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

    • Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

    • Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

    • Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

    • Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

    • Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

    • Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

    Who you work with

    You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you.

    You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second.

    Full-Stack Engineer - Broker Terms Team

    Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

    We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join the Broker Terms team.

    You’ll build the systems behind every offer iwoca makes through brokers, and see your work in the terms each business gets.

    The company

    Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

    That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

    We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

    The team

    Broker Terms is a growing team that owns the full offer terms strategy for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – both first-time and repeat customers. It sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the offer user interface (UI) brokers use in the Introducer Portal. The broker network is iwoca's biggest acquisition channel, and the team is directly responsible for the terms that win those customers.

    The team is small and interdisciplinary – commercial strategy, engineering and data science. It turns business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into timely decisions. It works on short-term gains and longer-term bets, and judges both by Customer Lifetime Value – what a business is worth to iwoca across all its borrowing.

    There are no fixed office days, and the team meets up for lunch once or twice a month.

    The role

    As a full-stack engineer in Broker Terms, you'll make changes across iwoca's codebase wherever they'd improve an offer. Most of it is backend – the code that calculates each offer's terms – with some frontend on the UI where brokers see them.

    You'll own features and projects from scoping and design through to production, and choose how to build them. You'll help decide what goes on the team's roadmap. You'll learn from the team's experienced engineers, and from the people who price broker offers.

    The team is light on process – a daily stand-up, a weekly meeting and regular retrospectives – and you'll have a say in how it works. Brokers see your changes in the Introducer Portal, and A/B tests show you which ones raised Customer Lifetime Value. Your work helps businesses get the funding they need.

    Live project examples:

    • Model-based pricing. Developing the systems that let a model set bespoke pricing for each customer.

    • No-fee test. Testing how the product performs without drawdown fees, and how that changes the way customers repay.

    • Loan durations. Building longer-duration Flexi-Loans with flexible repayments.

    • Offer display. Improving how offers appear to brokers and customers – a better journey, and easier testing for the team's data scientists.

    • Commission systems. Upgrading iwoca's broker commission systems.

    The requirements

    Essential:

    • Backend engineering. You've designed and built backend systems that run in production, ideally in Python, Django and PostgreSQL. You've modelled their data with performance and maintenance in mind.

    • Frontend engineering. You've built and maintained user interfaces in production, ideally in TypeScript and React.

    • Ownership. You've taken features end to end, and kept them working once people relied on them.

    • Trade-offs. You've weighed delivery speed against the long-term health of a system, and can explain what you chose and why.

    • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

    • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

    Bonus:

    • DevOps. You've used containers and CI/CD pipelines to deploy your code.

    • Experimentation. You've worked on A/B tests or other experiments, and used the results to decide what to build next.

    • Product thinking. You've found the business need behind a feature request, and planned the technical work to meet it.

    • Financial services. You've worked on lending, payments or pricing systems.

    The salary

    We expect to pay from £60,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

    The culture

    At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

    We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better.     OUR MISSION

    To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

    What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

    In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

    And we’re a long way from done!

    THE ROLE

    We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow.

    Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers.

    Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars.

    We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses.

    That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve.

     

    WHAT YOU'LL DO

    • Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years.

    • Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger.

    • Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience.

    • Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it.

    • Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers.

    Introduction to Role & Team

    Bumble Inc. is looking for an Enforcement Appeals Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on candidate who thrives in a cross-functional environment and is excited to support the evolution of our Trust Operations team.

    In this position, you will investigate and respond to members' appeals as a result of account restrictions and content moderation. You will help uphold Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines by reviewing and enforcing actions on violating accounts and content to maintain a safe and respectful environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with sensitive content, including child exploitation, graphic or physical sexual violence, suicide and self-harm, and other potentially distressing material.

    Trust and safety are embedded in Bumble Inc.’s mission of creating a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable. Our wider Trust organization includes centralized and dedicated teams focused on:

    • Creating products and systems that proactively detect and prevent harm and promote healthy, kind relationships.

    • Developing policies that govern and adjudicate responsible, safe, inclusive, and respectful behaviour and content across all Bumble Inc. platforms.

    • Supporting members who experience safety incidents in a trauma-informed, empathetic manner.

    This role will be based in London, UK reporting to the Enforcement Appeals Manager.

    Please note: This position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.

    What You’ll Do

    • Review and take action on members’ appeals for content removals, account bans, or other enforcement actions in a timely and accurate manner.

    • Provide high-touch, trauma-informed safety support to members who have experienced safety incidents.

    • Collaborate with internal teams, including Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, to escalate and resolve complex safety cases.

    • Help enforce Bumble Inc.’s policies by reviewing and processing accounts and content flagged for safety violations.

    • Participate in on-call rotations, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

    About You

    • Have 2–4 years of experience in a Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, or content moderation role, preferably in a high-risk or safety-focused environment.

    • Have demonstrated ability to work with sensitive content and provide support in cases involving child exploitation, sexual violence, and self-harm.

    • Have experience handling high-touch safety escalations, particularly those involving vulnerable individuals.

    • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, empathetic, and professional responses.

    • Have experience collaborating with Business Process Outsourcers (BPOs) to ensure quality and consistency in safety-related workflows (preferred).

    • Are able to work independently, prioritize urgent tasks, and make sound judgment calls under pressure.

    • Have proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another second language (preferred).

    • Are passionate about Bumble’s mission and values.

    • Are empathetic, resilient, and comfortable working in emotionally challenging situations.

    • Have a strong understanding of online safety issues and best practices in Trust & Safety.

    • Are detail-oriented and able to balance efficiency with thoughtful decision-making.

    • Are comfortable working flexible hours to support global teams and participating in on-call shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

    Benefits & Perks

    • Annual personal learning & development budget

    • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

    • Private Dental Insurance

    • Babylon Health app

    • Mental health support

    • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

    • Unlimited PTO

    • Subsidised gym membership

    • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

    • Premium App Access

    About Us

    Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

    We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews.     At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people.     Hi, we’re Back Market.

    We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

    Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

    Are you ready to join us?

    Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth.

    You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

     

    This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business.

    Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes.     Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Build the readiness that turns major change into lasting value.

As our Delivery and Deployment Excellence Leader, Americas, you will lead regional business readiness, solution quality, deployment excellence and adoption for Oracle E-Business Suite upgrades and enhancements. You will connect global program direction with practical execution across the Americas, helping business teams prepare for testing, cutover, go-live, stabilization and the move into business-as-usual operations.

This is a senior, highly influential role working across business and technology teams. You will shape regional priorities, guide trade-offs and create a consistent approach that supports process standardization, productivity and stronger business outcomes.

This role is based in the USA.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Order Management, Distribution, Finance, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Global Trade Services and commercial teams across the Americas to assess requirements, define process scenarios and acceptance criteria, and align regional priorities with the approved ERP roadmap.

  • Oversee system integration, user acceptance, regression and other testing cycles, including milestones, defect triage, resolution, retesting and business sign-off for material issues.
  • Establish regional readiness criteria aligned with global governance, maintaining a clear view of actions, dependencies, risks, issues and overall deployment health.
  • Develop and lead deployment, cutover, go-live and stabilization plans with accountable business and technology owners, supporting a controlled transition into everyday operations.
  • Coordinate regional change and adoption activity, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training and readiness in partnership with functional and change leads.
  • Connect global program leaders, regional business leaders, technology teams and commercial entities, influencing decisions that protect delivery, adoption and business outcomes.
  • Partner with regional counterparts to build common standards, share lessons and develop reusable deployment playbooks and practices.
  • Monitor post-go-live performance, sponsor timely issue resolution and capture lessons that strengthen future deployments.
  • Be a thought leader in identifying and ideating AI based solutoins with ERP as a backbone to improve the regional business process performance and employee productivity.

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, technology, supply chain, finance or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Substantial experience in enterprise transformation, ERP delivery, business deployment, testing or change execution, including complex regional or cross-regional delivery.
  • Strong knowledge of end-to-end business processes and the connections between commercial, customer service, finance, distribution and supply chain operations.
  • Experience leading readiness, testing, cutover, go-live and stabilization for large-scale technology or process change.
  • The ability to use data, milestones and readiness measures to assess delivery health and support timely decisions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication across functions, cultures, regions and time zones.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Oracle E-Business Suite or a comparable enterprise ERP platform.
  • A relevant program, project, testing or change management certification.
  • Experience in regulated healthcare, medical devices or a similarly complex environment.

What Sets You Apart

  • Constructive challenge: You raise difficult issues early, test assumptions and help leaders make informed decisions.
  • Practical judgement: You turn broad program direction into clear priorities and workable regional plans.
  • Calm accountability: You maintain focus through competing demands, uncertainty and high-impact delivery moments.
  • Influence without authority: You create alignment across teams and move shared work forward through trust and clarity.
  • Enterprise perspective: You balance regional needs with common standards and long-term business value.

At Resmed, the work we do helps people breathe better and live healthier, longer lives. In this role, you will help ensure significant technology and process changes are introduced with care, discipline and a clear focus on the people who use them. Your leadership will strengthen how teams across the Americas prepare for change, adopt new ways of working and sustain the intended business outcomes.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue
  • All candidates must be located in one of the following states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Global University Systems is an international education group that empowers students to transform their lives through education. We believe education drives careers, lives, and society forward, enabling a brighter future for all. Our network of 30 institutions offers the broadest range of industry-relevant skills through inclusive, accessible, and digital-first learning. We currently educate around 122,000 students on campuses worldwide and have 20M+ unique subscribers to our courses. Our global ecosystem powers accessible digital learning and academic achievement.

Position

The Business Development Manager for International Student Recruitment will oversee all student recruitment activities, business development activities, account management, and marketing events for B2B channels across the country or region you will manage. You will collaborate with Company Directors to develop B2B channels and implement marketing and sales strategies to promote international student recruitment for GUS. You will be representing one of our universities or colleges located in either Europe, North America, or Asia.

Requirements

Essential Criteria

  • You will have experience in international student recruitment for higher education.
    • You have an established and relevant agency network and solid relationships with key stakeholders within these agencies.
    • A solid understanding of industry trends is essential to inform the group’s strategic planning and forecasting.
    • You will have developed and trained education agents on how to promote the brand you represent.

    • You will have experience generating new revenue from existing streams and accounts, as well as identifying new opportunities.
    • You will have a proven track record of assisting in identifying, supporting, and developing potential business partners and growing existing client relationships.
    • You will have experience performing client research, including (but not limited to) meeting and engaging with key players in the industry.
    • You will be a highly motivated individual who strives for success in all areas.
    • You are confident in delivering workshops and presentations, hosting conferences, and being in front of the camera.

Desirable Criteria

  • Salesforce or database management experience.
    • We will consider applicants who have represented an institution directly (located anywhere within your region) or who have significant agency experience where they have managed a sub-network of agents.

Location

The position is home-based with travel across MENA region. Ideally, you will be located within your country and able to travel with ease, as your main marketing activities will be held in this area (where agents are based).

Other Information

Please note this position is only available on our consultancy agreement.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) Analyst to support our Corporate Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC). In this role, you will conduct large-scale cyber data analytics, lead the use of detection technologies, perform advanced threat hunting, and provide technical review of team member work. The ideal candidate is decisive, deadline‑oriented, and produces high‑quality analytic output. The DFIR Analyst works closely with the CSOC Manager to deliver detailed security event analysis, support business units, and foster collaboration across IT teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Protect the organization's IT assets as a member of the Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC).
  • Implement DFIR strategies to identify risks and reduce gaps in host and network security controls.
  • Collaborate with IT Operations and end users to proactively prevent intrusions and support incident response efforts.
  • Prepare CSOC reports documenting security incidents from discovery through remediation.
  • Support vulnerability and cyber risk management by continuously monitoring threats and exposures.
  • Test and evaluate technology solutions in preparation for both small and large-scale deployments.
  • Participate in periodic on-call rotations supporting 24/7 cybersecurity operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or 4 additional years of experience in a cybersecurity-related field in lieu of degree, or equivalent Security Operations work experience.
  • Experience with Splunk Enterprise Security or Splunk Certified Power User. Advanced Splunk certification is a plus.
  • DFIR experience using Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) technologies.
  • Experience performing forensic analysis on various evidence types including disk, memory, network, and cloud artifacts.
  • Proficient with common scripting and programming languages.
  • Experience with Risk Management Frameworks.
  • In-depth understanding of common security controls for Windows, Linux, and network equipment.
  • Strong attention to detail, time‑management skills, and a professional demeanor.
  • US Citizenship.

Target Salary Range

$80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

About the Role

CatFace is seeking a Contract Commercial Video & Photo Editor to support the Marketing team with merchandise launches, campaigns, and external brand partnerships through high-quality post-production work.

This role is responsible for editing a wide variety of creative assets, including animated advertisements, live-action commercials, product marketing videos, ecommerce photography, and lifestyle imagery.   • Export web-ready assets according to platform specifications.

Collaboration & Asset Management

  • Work closely with Marketing to execute campaign concepts.
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions efficiently while maintaining project timelines.
  • Organize project files and maintain clean asset management practices.
  • Ensure all deliverables meet CatFace brand standards and quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience editing commercial, advertising, marketing, or branded content.
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro.

  • Experience editing both video and photography assets.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual communication.
  • Experience working with voiceovers, sound design, music, and audio mixing.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and file organization skills.

Job Details

  • Location: Remote

  • Hours: Based on campaign and/or launch schedules

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> India (remote)
</p>

<p><strong>Role Purpose</strong></p>
<p>We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.</p>
<p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p>
<p>Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)<br>Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.<br>Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX<br>Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.<br>Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.<br>Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.</p>

      <title>Abnormal: Director of Security Engineering</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>Abnormal AI protects organizations from the most sophisticated email and collaboration attacks using behavioral AI. Security is not a bolt-on at Abnormal; it is core to the product we sell and the trust our customers place in us. Our security organization operates a commercial cloud environment and a separate FedRAMP-authorized environment, and we are pursuing increasingly rigorous federal authorizations as we grow.</p>
<p>We are hiring a Director of Security reporting to the CISO and leading the Security Engineering organization. You will build and scale high-performing security teams, own major security programs end to end, and operate autonomously in the CISO's absence, including representing security to executive leadership, customers, and auditors.</p>
<p>This is a role for a deeply technical leader with a software engineering background who has grown into people leadership. You have built security teams from the ground up, you write and review code and architecture when it matters, and you believe the best security organizations earn their influence through partnership rather than policy enforcement.</p>
<h2>Our Security Philosophy</h2>
<p>We run security the way the best engineering-led companies do:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Security reduces toil.</strong> Our job is to make the rest of the company faster and safer at the same time. If a control adds friction without reducing risk, it is a defect.</li>
<li><strong>Paved paths, safe by default.</strong> We invest in guardrails, golden paths, and secure-by-default infrastructure so the easy choice is the secure choice. We prefer preventing classes of problems over chasing individual findings.</li>
<li><strong>Partnership over gatekeeping.</strong> Security succeeds only through deep collaboration with engineering, IT, and business teams. We embed with builders, we ship alongside them, and we take on their constraints as our own.</li>
<li><strong>Engineering-grade rigor.</strong> We treat security problems as engineering problems: automated, measurable, code-reviewed, and continuously improved.</li>
</ul>
<p>If the security cultures that value freedom and responsibility, context over control, and guardrails over gates resonate with you, you will feel at home here.</p>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Serve as deputy to the CISO: act with full authority in the CISO's absence and represent the security organization to executives, customers, and regulators.</li>
<li>Lead, coach, and grow managers and senior engineers across Security Engineering and Security Operations.</li>
<li>Own the security engineering roadmap: cloud security architecture (AWS-first), detection and response, identity, vulnerability management, and secure-by-default platform investments.</li>
<li>Drive cross-functional programs with Engineering, IT, and Product, from AI security governance to data perimeter controls to federal compliance initiatives.</li>
<li>Set and defend engineering standards for the security organization: everything as code, automated where possible, measured against outcomes rather than activity.</li>
<li>Build hiring pipelines and raise the bar on every hire; own performance management, promotion cases, and succession planning within your teams.</li>
<li>Translate technical risk into business terms for the executive team and board, and translate business priorities into a coherent security strategy.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Must Haves</h2>
<ul>
<li>10+ years in security or software engineering, including 4+ years managing security teams, ideally including managers of managers or equivalent scope.</li>
<li>A genuine software engineering background: you have shipped production software, and you evaluate security solutions the way an engineer would.</li>
<li>A proven record of building and scaling high-performing security teams, with alumni who would work for you again.</li>
<li>Deep technical fluency in cloud-native environments: AWS organizations and multi-account governance, Kubernetes, identity and access, detection engineering, and modern SDLC security.</li>
<li>Demonstrated cross-functional leadership: you have earned the trust of engineering leaders and shipped security outcomes through their teams, not around them.</li>
<li>Strong written communication: you produce decision-ready documents and can drive alignment asynchronously.</li>
<li>Executive presence: comfortable presenting to C-level leadership, customers, and auditors without preparation from the CISO.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Strong Signals</h2>
<ul>
<li>You are currently a security engineering manager or senior manager at a fintech, high-growth startup, or forward-leaning enterprise, and you are ready for broader scope.</li>
<li>You have built paved-path or secure-by-default platforms that measurably reduced both risk and developer friction.</li>
<li>Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) without letting compliance define the security program.</li>
<li>Experience securing AI/ML systems or governing AI adoption at scale.</li>
<li>You have operated in environments where security headcount was scarce and automation was the only way to scale.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Why This Role</h2>
<p>You will inherit strong teams, an executive staff that treats security as a first-class function, and a CISO who wants a true partner rather than a lieutenant. The scope is broad, the autonomy is real, and the ceiling on this role is defined by what you take on.</p>
<p>#LI-ML1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.<br>In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.</p></div><div class="title">Base salary range:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$214,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$308,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A note on AI in our process:&nbsp;<br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.</p>
<p>Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt9cbda641db7c0045/6a1e3d3a66aea075cd33e462/AAP_and_EEO_Statement.pdf"><span><em>click here</em></span></a>. If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please&nbsp;<em><span><a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt4eb3a265cc7b1ca9/6a1e3d3bfe33e73c16ff026b/EEOC_Know_Your_Rights_Oct_30_2025.pdf">click here</a></span></em>.</p></div>

<p>

</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong><br>Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, building the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.</p>
<p>As a Software Engineer, you’ll work with experienced engineers to build, test, and support well-scoped improvements to the execution engine. You’ll learn how Dremio’s query runtime works while contributing to areas such as query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, scheduling, and performance.<br><br><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and support execution-engine components: Implement, test, debug, and maintain well-defined changes to query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, and resource management.</li>
<li>Develop reliable software: Write clear, maintainable Java code; add unit and integration tests; and follow established engineering practices for code review, testing, and documentation.</li>
<li>Investigate issues: Help diagnose query correctness, reliability, and performance issues using query profiles, logs, telemetry, benchmarks, and production data.</li>
<li>Learn runtime and performance fundamentals: Build familiarity with vectorized processing, concurrency, memory usage, parallelism, data exchange, and disk spilling.</li>
<li>Collaborate with the team: Work closely with senior engineers and partner teams to understand requirements, break work into manageable tasks, and deliver incremental improvements.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation, while validating results through testing, review, and sound engineering judgment.</li>
<li>Grow your engineering skills: Participate actively in design discussions and code reviews, seek feedback, and steadily take on broader technical responsibility.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Software engineering foundation: Up to two years of professional software development experience, or equivalent experience through internships, coursework, or substantial personal projects.</li>
<li>Programming skills: Proficiency in Java or another object-oriented programming language; willingness to learn and work in a large Java codebase.</li>
<li>Computer science fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and basic concurrency concepts.</li>
<li>Problem-solving ability: Able to work through well-defined technical problems, ask good questions, and apply feedback to reach a solution.</li>
<li>Quality mindset: Commitment to writing tested, maintainable code and learning established development, testing, and review practices.</li>
<li>Communication and collaboration: Able to communicate progress, surface blockers early, and work effectively with teammates.</li>
<li>Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>Exposure to database internals, query processing, distributed systems, or large-scale data processing.</li>
<li>Familiarity with performance-oriented software concepts such as profiling, memory management, concurrency, or vectorized processing.</li>
<li>Experience with C++, Apache Arrow, Parquet, Apache Iceberg, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.</li>
<li>Contributions to open-source projects.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>What we value&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.</span></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click </span></em><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CB96QFmOX-bFy48YFOe2GO5lmdawOpKKBj8DpTgsuNg/edit?usp=sharing"><em><span>here</span></em></a><em><span> to review the privacy notice.&nbsp;</span></em></p>
<h3><strong>Important Security Notice for Candidates</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public.       <title>PagerDuty: Senior Director, Field Enablement</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (USA - San Francisco, CA)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h2>
<p>PagerDuty is seeking a <strong>Sr. Director, Field Enablement</strong> to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As Sr. Director of&nbsp; Field Enablement, you will lead a team of enablement professionals supporting our sales, customer success, and partnership organizations.&nbsp;</p>
<p>You will build and scale our global enablement function to ensure our customer-facing teams are equipped to sell and support our diversifying product portfolio as we enter our next phase of growth. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the enablement strategy for a high-growth SaaS company and directly improve teams' capabilities and productivity worldwide. The ideal candidate is a strategic, seasoned enablement leader passionate about gathering customer feedback and competitive intelligence to develop programs that drive sales excellence and business results.</p>
<h2><strong>ABOUT PAGERDUTY</strong></h2>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Develop, execute, optimize, and assess enablement programs in partnership with sales and customer success leadership, determining priorities and success metrics with key stakeholders</li>
<li>Gather and share insights from customers, competitors, and the market to enable the positioning of PagerDuty’s value proposition to the market</li>
<li>Drive the creation of learning programs and events that align with overall sales and company strategy, enhancing team capabilities, productivity, and high-level selling skills</li>
<li>Build and maintain an enablement delivery platform that provides scalable, measurable content and learning resources to sales, customer success, and partnership teams</li>
<li>Collaborate with marketing and product marketing to develop highly effective and repeatable sales messaging, selling tools, and collateral that enable consistent execution</li>
<li>Design and maintain an end-to-end sales onboarding program in collaboration with HR that certifies new hires on company strategy, product messaging, and sales processes</li>
<li>Develop and lead the everboarding process for the sales team to ensure the continued development of required behaviors and skills to successfully operate a consumption driven business</li>
<li>Build out and scale enablement support functions for Customer Success and Partnerships organizations</li>
<li>Communicate the enablement strategy, roadmap, and KPIs to stakeholders across all global organizations</li>
<li>Develop and maintain a library of sales enablement resources, including sales playbooks, battle cards, product collateral, content library, and competitive intelligence</li>
<li>Drive adoption and utilization of sales enablement tools such as MindTickle and Highspot</li>
<li>Partner with the sales systems team to drive adoption and utilization of sales tools such as Clari, Salesloft, Salesforce, and others</li>
<li>Conduct regular assessments and audits of sales processes and identify areas for improvement and optimization.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Set key metrics to assess the impact of sales enablement efforts on sales performance</li>
<li>Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in sales enablement</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA is a plus</li>
<li>10+ years of sales enablement experience or a combination of sales / post sales, sales training, and enablement roles</li>
<li>5+ years of management experience leading and developing enablement teams</li>
<li>Proven track record of building and delivering innovative, strategic sales enablement programs, including training, onboarding, certifications, and sales events</li>
<li>Experience implementing and maintaining content management platforms such as Highspot or Seismic</li>
<li>3+ years of experience in high-velocity, high-growth startup environments, preferably in the SaaS space, or equivalent degree or experience</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Strong understanding of sales methodologies such as Force Management, MEDDIC and forecasting best practices</li>
<li>Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively train and influence sales professionals at all levels</li>
<li>Experience with Sales Operations and <a href="http://salesforce.com">Salesforce.com</a></li>
<li>Proficiency in using sales enablement tools, CRM systems, and content management platforms. Preferred platforms include Salesforce, Seismic, CRM Analytics, and more</li>
<li>Analytical mindset with the ability to provide actionable insights</li>
<li>Knowledge of Sales Manager training and sales coaching, particularly for Enterprise sales</li>
<li>Strong program and project management skills with the ability to maintain calendars of ongoing training, business reviews, and field communications</li>
<li>Detail and results-oriented with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on execution</li>
<li>Collaborative and team-oriented approach with the ability to work cross-functionally</li>
<li>Self-motivated and results-driven with a passion for driving sales excellence</li>
<li>Excel in creating and curating sales collateral, playbooks, training modules, and other resources to support the sales team</li>
<li>Have a track record of driving sales enablement initiatives across different regions and markets, understanding cultural nuances and local sales practices</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>The base salary range for this position is 180,000 - 303,600 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.</p>
<p>Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.</p>
<p>Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Hesitant to apply?</strong></p>
<p>We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/jobalerts">job alerts</a>!</p>
<p><strong>Where we work</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/locations">offices</a> in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we <strong>cannot</strong> employ candidates residing in:</p>
<p><strong>Location restrictions: </strong><strong><br></strong><strong>Australia:</strong> Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia<br><strong>Canada:</strong> Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon<br><strong>United States:</strong> Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming<br><em>Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.</em></p>
<p><strong>How we work</strong></p>
<p><a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/#values">Our values</a> guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.</p>
<p>People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.</p>
<p><strong>What we offer</strong></p>
<p>As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/global-benefits">benefits site</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Your package may include:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive salary</li>
<li>Comprehensive benefits package&nbsp;</li>
<li>Flexible work arrangements</li>
<li>Company equity*</li>
<li>ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*</li>
<li>Retirement or pension plan*</li>
<li>Generous paid vacation time</li>
<li>Paid holidays and sick leave</li>
<li>Dutonian Wellness Days &amp; HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO</li>
<li>Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*</li>
<li>Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year</li>
<li>Company-wide hack weeks</li>
<li>Mental wellness programs</li>
</ul>
<p>*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure</p>
<p><strong>About PagerDuty</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses</p>
<p>PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Go behind-the-scenes on our <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/home">careers site</a> and @pagerduty on Instagram.</p>
<p><strong>Additional Information</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's <a href="https://www.pagerduty.com/privacy-policy/">Privacy Policy</a>.</p>
<p>PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.</p>
<p>PagerDuty uses the E-Verify employment verification program.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-senior-director-field-enablement">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-senior-director-field-enablement</a></p>
</description>
